bullets.text: SwitchBot Wallet Finder: Essential Accessory - This sleek device tracks wallets via **Apple's** Find My app, enhancing lost item recovery.
ChatGPT Voice Feature Retiring - **OpenAI** will discontinue the Voice feature on macOS, focusing on unified experiences across platforms.
AI Safety Legislation in New York - Governor Kathy Hochul signs the **RAISE Act**, enhancing regulations for AI developers in the state.
iRobot's Bankruptcy: A Cautionary Tale - The Roomba maker's downfall highlights regulatory challenges in tech acquisitions, as discussed by founder Colin Angle.
Customizing ChatGPT's Tone - **OpenAI** introduces options to adjust ChatGPT's warmth and enthusiasm, enhancing user interaction.
Bluetooth 6.0: Future of Connectivity - The new standard promises reduced latency and improved location tracking for wireless devices.
Nex Playground: A Mixed Review - This new gaming console captivates kids despite its technical shortcomings and subscription model.
Rivian's AI Ambitions - The EV maker pivots to develop its own self-driving technology, aiming for higher autonomy levels.
